articles.title: Asian Stocks Set for Losses as Bond Jitters Linger: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg
articles.description: Asian stocks dropped as a semiconductor selloff deepened, with investors retreating from one of the year’s hottest trades amid elevated bond yields and geopolitical uncertainty. Treasuries stabilized following recent losses.
